# Pane Renderer Contract

Defines the responsibilities, guarantees, and integration rules for
rendering pane content within the Prismata/PCMS‑2026 UI ecosystem.

The pane renderer is responsible for drawing:

1. Borders (structural styling)
2. Canvas (background fill)
3. Colour styling (foreground/background)
4. Content (supplied by commands)
5. Carousel items (if enabled)
6. Diff relational pairs (if diff_view)
7. Header styling (if present)
